BiblicalUsage: Machir = "sold"; 1) eldest son of Manasseh by an Aramite or Syrian concubine and progenitor of a large family; 2) son of Ammiel, a powerful chief of one of the Transjordanic tribes who rendered essential services to Saul and to David
